text:
maya_cs: morning team — DriftGrid private deploy: customer reports no audit logs and KMS denies decrypt. Pilot is tomorrow, need triage.

dan_infra: checking network and peering now. Peering active but BGP routes not learned on their side.

li_sec: KMS error in runtime logs: AccessDenied when trying to decrypt object. Key policy lists role arn:aws:iam::888999000:role/drift-logs-writer-old. Customer uses arn:aws:iam::888999000:role/drift-logs-writer.

sana_support: customer contact tony@driftgrid says they rotated roles recently. He asked if Redwood can provide the minimal policy statement.

li_sec: recommend this minimal snippet for key policy (principal -> specific role, actions: kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey):

```
{ "Sid":"AllowDriftForwarder","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::888999000:role/drift-logs-writer"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*" }
```

li_sec: will add verification steps: `aws sts get-caller-identity` and `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.blob`.

dan_infra: temporary mitigation: I'll push a static route for 10.80.0.0/16 on our side to unblock traffic; please confirm once you accept peering.

maya_cs: capture risk: if pilot misses tomorrow, customer may delay PO. I'll offer a one-off pilot extension if delay is on our side.

sana_support: filed doc request: add mapping in console from request-id -> SSEKMSKeyId for audit clarity.

audit-bot: Audit delivery: 0 files ingested in last 60m, latest PutObject error code KMS.AccessDenied.

maya_cs: action items: 1) Add role to key policy or grant -> owner li_sec, ETA today EOD. 2) Static route stopgap -> owner dan_infra, ETA 2h. 3) Console mapping request -> owner sana_support, ETA 48h. Reconnect in this thread after updates.

-- thread end --
